records.prompt: Production game art repair. Use case stylized-concept. ONE enormous teal salvage-steel ocean leviathan, chains and orange turbine lights boss hull for Star Guard. Rich polished shaded prerendered arcade artwork, directly overhead orthographic view, front towards BOTTOM. Full coherent broad silhouette with central spine and articulated lateral wings. No detached pieces, text, floor, outer shadow or background. Actual transparent background alpha. Center the entire boss with at least 15 percent transparent padding on all four sides, no clipped wings or appendages. This is the supporting HULL only: leave five dark recessed sockets, two at upper left/right, two at lower left/right, one in center for separate destructible weapons to attach. Do not paint bright cores or separate cannon turrets into these sockets. Keep surfaces detailed but silhouette strong at small game size. Authentic complex spacecraft/chitin texture, no geometric placeholders. Reference is the existing matching boss in supplied atlas; preserve theme but repair matte and silhouette.
